explanation: Retrospective two-part detector: it fires (about 0.4-0.9x max) on an appearance/perception linking verb (look, seem, sound, smell, taste, feel in any inflection, e.g. looks/looked, seems/seemed, sounds, smells, felt) used as a verb after its subject or a modal, and (about 0.7x max) on the first '.' or first line break of a text, whichever comes first; noun uses ('loud sounds outside'), appear/become/remain/is, later periods, '!' and '?' do not drive it, but a text's tokens 2-3 (e.g. 'Revenue grew', 'Once upon'), ' the' after a preposition ('in the city') and a closing month name ('in June') can also reach 0.25-0.6x max. Inactive class (whole-text peak over every token after the first stays below 0.25x max, measured on 19 texts with max 0.16x): texts of 8-16 tokens that open with the fixed words 'Our team and our coach' followed by one plain clause containing no '.', no line break, no '!' or '?', no ' the', no month or date word, and none of those linking verbs; anything outside these limits (other openings, longer texts, any sentence boundary) is not claimed inactive.
